question: Hiuen Tsang visited Kanchipuram, the capital of Pallavas, during the reign which of the following rulers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narasimha Varman I.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hiuen Tsang** visited Kanchipuram, the capital of **Pallavas**, during the reign of** Narasimha Varman I.**
 
• Narsimha Verman I was the most famous ruler of the **Pallva Dynasty.**
